conditions.title: tenantId real
conditions.required_evidence: Real tenantId is present in a safe observed signal.

conditions.title: organizationId real
conditions.required_evidence: Real organizationId is present in a safe observed signal.

conditions.title: sessionId real
conditions.required_evidence: Real sessionId is present in a safe observed signal.

conditions.title: activityId real
conditions.required_evidence: Real activityId is present in a safe observed signal.

conditions.title: actorId/userId real
conditions.required_evidence: Real actorId or userId is present without leaking personal data.

conditions.title: provenance real
conditions.required_evidence: Real provenance includes stable source identity/path/locator.

conditions.title: sourceTrace real if candidates
conditions.required_evidence: Candidate signals preserve sourceTrace from real non-mutating evidence.

conditions.title: idempotencyKey real
conditions.required_evidence: Real idempotencyKey is present or safely derived read-only.

conditions.title: correlationId real
conditions.required_evidence: Real correlationId is present or safely derived read-only.

conditions.title: officialFlowRef real
conditions.required_evidence: Real officialFlowRef exists without executing or mutating official flow.

conditions.title: proof no UI touch
conditions.required_evidence: Observer does not import, mount, hook or mutate UI/app/components/pages.

conditions.title: proof no WorkMap mutation
conditions.required_evidence: Observer does not write or mutate WorkMap state or files.

conditions.title: proof no Significado mutation
conditions.required_evidence: Observer does not write or mutate Significado state or files.

conditions.title: proof no DB write
conditions.required_evidence: No insert/update/delete/query execution with write authority.

conditions.title: proof no Supabase requirement or controlled read boundary
conditions.required_evidence: No Supabase dependency, or fully proven read-only boundary.

conditions.title: proof no registry/export/diagnosis
conditions.required_evidence: No registry write, final export, or diagnosis enablement.

conditions.title: proof RLS/auth/tenant isolation if DB/read boundary appears
conditions.required_evidence: If DB read ever appears, RLS/auth/tenant isolation must be proven before preflight retry.
